protocol.split: 70% train / 30% held out, stratified independently per seed
protocol.sequence: target digit once -> independent real-digit distractors -> zero query
protocol.feedback_order: predict zero query with theta_t, score, then optionally update readout
protocol.trainable_scope: readout only; injection and transitions are frozen

gate_controls.oracle_cue_only: write only the known cue event
gate_controls.random_one_write: write one uniformly sampled content frame without cue/label access

protocol.state_reset: reset at every independent target sequence
protocol.evaluation: held-out targets/distractors with learning disabled and zero-drift audit
limitations: three seeds are a mechanism screen, not confirmatory evidence
the oracle gate is supplied by the protocol and is not learned
the task tests protected fading memory, not delayed credit into the gate
only readout weights learn; injection and transition learning are not tested
the random reservoir is not a language model or a Go policy
this experiment cannot support animal-level learning claims
